type.description:
### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

Lets the actor save the target's location under the given ID, for later teleportation via [Teleport To Location](../entity_action_types/teleport_to_location.md).
type.markdownDescription:
### ⚠️ Requires [Sync](https://modrinth.com/mod/sync) to be installed! ⚠️

Lets the actor save the target's location under the given ID, for later teleportation via [Teleport To Location](../entity_action_types/teleport_to_location.md).

id.description: Unique identifier for this saved location.
id.markdownDescription: Unique identifier for this saved location.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing location with the same ID.
overwrite.markdownDescription: Whether to overwrite an existing location with the same ID.

track_entity.description: If true, the saved location follows the target across future ticks (resolved at teleport time); otherwise the target's current position is frozen as a static location.
track_entity.markdownDescription: If true, the saved location follows the target across future ticks (resolved at teleport time); otherwise the target's current position is frozen as a static location.
